title: North Korea launches ballistic missiles with variable trajectories and prime minister orders maximum alert
summary: North Korea conducted several ballistic missile launches that fell outside Japan's EEZ, some with irregular flight, as the Japanese government strengthens its vigilance.

title: Dodgers lose first NLCS game against Brewers despite Ohtani's first hit and run
summary: Shohei Ohtani recorded his first hit of the series and scored the opening run, but the Brewers rallied to defeat the Dodgers in Game 1 of the National League Championship Series.

title: Five Malaysians arrested for attempting to smuggle five kilograms of cocaine hidden in shoe soles
summary: Japanese police arrested five Malaysian nationals for allegedly concealing cocaine worth over 100 million yen inside shoe insoles.

title: Yamaguchi-gumi yakuza recruits women to send abroad as phone scam operators
summary: Members of the Yamaguchi-gumi crime group were arrested for allegedly coercing women to travel overseas and work in phone fraud centers.

title: Houthis attack Saudi airport again leaving one dead as Iran offers to mediate to reduce tension
summary: A Houthi rebel attack on an airport in Saudi Arabia left one dead, while Iran expressed willingness to support de-escalation of the conflict.

title: Woman arrested for withdrawing money with deceased brother's card in Hokkaido
summary: Hokkaido police arrested the sister of a man whose body was found dead, accused of using his bank card to withdraw cash after his death.

title: Japanese government begins debate on introducing nuclear-powered submarines amid internal divisions
summary: The Prime Minister's Office is pushing a study on acquiring nuclear-powered submarines, while cautious opinions persist within the executive.

title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agreed to energy ceasefire, but Zelensky denies it
summary: Former U.S. President Donald Trump asserted that Moscow and Kiev agreed to a truce on energy infrastructure, a claim the Ukrainian president called false.
